papers.title: The Physics of Multi-Turn Long-Horizon Planning: From Pre-training to Post-training via Single- and Multi-Teacher On-Policy Agentic Distillation
papers.abstract: Multi-turn long-horizon planning is critical for foundation model agents, yet how to fundamentally improve it remains unclear. Existing models are trained on uncontrollable and opaque Internet data, making it difficult to identify how planning ability is acquired, shaped, and integrated. To address this challenge, we introduce a unified and controlled multi-turn environment that enables precise control. It allows systematically study long-horizon planning across three stages. papers.llm_reason: 直击 Agent 工程化最核心的未解难题：多轮长程规划能力究竟在训练的哪个阶段获得、如何被塑造。论文构建了一个统一可控的多轮环境，将规划能力的习得分解为预训练、对齐、智能体蒸馏三个阶段，并用单/多教师 on-policy 蒸馏系统性地隔离每个阶段的贡献。这对所有构建 Agent 的团队有直接方法论价值——当前业界普遍困惑'规划能力到底是基座模型带来的还是后训练/RL 蒸馏带来的'，这篇工作提供了可控实验范式来回答这个问题。工程价值高：多教师 on-policy agentic distillation 是可直接迁移到 Agent 训练管线的具体技术。证据强度中等偏高（受控环境+消融设计），但代码/benchmark 暂无待核验，摘要截断。

papers.title: DataOrchestra: Learning to Orchestrate Per-Example Curation of Pretraining Data
papers.abstract: Pretraining data processing is critical to the downstream performance of Large Language Models (LLMs). However, many existing approaches define a fixed processing strategy at the corpus or domain level and apply it uniformly to many examples, without adapting to the needs of each example. We propose DataOrchestra, a framework that unifies different processing operations and orchestrates an example-specific pipeline for each example. papers.llm_reason: 提出了 DataOrchestra——将预训练数据处理从'语料级固定策略'升级为'逐样本编排'的框架。orchestrator 对每个数据 chunk 决定执行哪些处理操作（过滤、去重、质量评分、格式转换等）。这直击 LLM 预训练数据工程的痛点：当前业界普遍用统一规则处理全量数据，但不同样本的质量、领域、噪声特性差异巨大，一刀切策略损失了大量信号。对任何自建预训练/继续预训练管线的团队，这是可借鉴的架构范式。作者团队（Shijie Xia、Pengfei Liu）在数据工程方向有积累。工程可验证性高（orchestrator 可用小模型实现，处理逻辑可独立验证），但完整效果需大规模预训练实验支撑，复现成本高。代码/benchmark 待核验。

papers.title: ClinFusion: A Vision-Centric Multimodal LLM System for Holistic Medical Understanding
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) hold immense potential to revolutionize clinical practice, yet deploying them in the medical domain is fundamentally a vision-centric challenge: models must absorb knowledge from heterogeneous 2D and 3D medical images, and evaluation protocols must align with radiologists' clinical practice and provide an accurate, fine-grained and factualness-driven assessment. papers.abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) adapts diffusion models by querying a teacher along trajectories generated by the current student, but how it should behave under classifier-free guidance (CFG), a default component of modern diffusion systems, remains poorly understood. papers.title: Efficient LLM-Generated Shuttling Compilers for Complex Trapped-Ion Architectures
papers.abstract: Trapped-ion quantum computers rely on shuttling compilers, which cast an input algorithm into a sequence of ion-qubit movements within a given architecture. We present the first study in which a single frontier large language model (LLM), Claude Opus 4.7, generates and iteratively refines the full Python code of shuttling compilers from written specifications. papers.llm_reason: 首个用单一前沿 LLM（Claude Opus 4.7）从书面规格生成并迭代优化完整 Python 离子穿梭编译器代码的研究——从线性分段阱到带结点的复杂架构。作为 coding-agent 的真实案例，它证明了前沿 LLM 在'领域专家级代码生成+迭代精化'上的能力边界：能处理量子计算编译器这种高度专业、强约束的代码任务。对评估 LLM 作为代码生成/软件工程 Agent 的能力上限有参考价值。作为长尾资产：它不是可直接迁移的方法，而是一个'LLM 能力前沿的探测点'，可用于校准对 LLM 编码能力的预期。工程可验证性高（编译器代码可执行验证），但与主流 AI Agent 工程栈的直接迁移距离中等。代码待核验。
